biggest_catch: Each payout tier requires the friend to hit a specific product - $50 for a Spending account with payroll direct deposit, another $50 for a $10,000+ personal loan, up to $100 for $100k+ in new deposits - so a friend who just opens a basic account earns you nothing.
catches: Referrer earns: $50 per new member who opens a primary personal Spending account with payroll direct deposit; $50 per friend who secures a funded personal loan of $10,000+ within 60 days of opening; $50 for $50,000-$99,999 in new deposits or $100 for $100,000+ in new deposits within 60 days.
Friend must be a new member: no HCU account for at least 12 months; 18+; referral form must be provided at account opening.
Bonus deposited to the member's Share account within 60 days of opening; all accounts must be in good standing.
Employees and volunteers of HCU are ineligible; not valid with any other offer; bonus reported on 1099-INT.

steps: Complete the Heartland referral form (online or printable) and give it to your friend.
Friend brings the finished form into a branch at account opening and opens a primary personal Spending account with payroll direct deposit.
If the friend also secures a $10,000+ personal loan within 60 days or brings large deposits, you earn additional tiers.
Bonuses are deposited to your Share account within 60 days of the friend's account opening.
timing: Bonus deposited to the referrer's Share account within 60 days of the friend's account opening.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus deposited to the referrer's Share account within 60 days of the friend's account opening. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
